{{Quote|Excellency, we've just received word from our contacts on Socorro. The Imperial Mission there is burning! The Princess is missing, and her protector, Elke Vetter, is dead!|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Oron Jaeger]], to Roan Fel|<ref name="Legacy 3" />}}
In [[137 ABY]], a '''duel''' between the [[Hand (One Sith)|Sith Hand]] [[Darth Talon]] and the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Elke Vetter]] took place in a courtyard of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro's]] [[Imperial Mission temple]]. Vetter had been traveling with [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Marasiah Fel]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]] on a quest to see who among [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] were still loyal to Marasiah's [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]], and they were welcomed into the temple by [[Imperial Mission]]ary [[Astraal Vao]].

When that news reached the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]], he dispatched Talon to Socorro in order to send Marasiah fleeing, which he hoped would in turn lead his [[One Sith]] to her father. After setting the temple on [[Fire/Legends|fire]], Talon [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] Vetter as Marasiah and Vao escaped, and she defeated her opponent by [[Cho mai/Legends|cutting off]] the Imperial Knight's left [[Limb/Legends|hand]] and [[Shiak|stabbing]] her in the thigh with her [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Talon then [[Force power/Legends|used]] [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Drain Knowledge|extract]] Marasiah's destination from Vetter's [[Brain/Legends|mind]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] her foe with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I have learned she is currently at the Imperial Mission on the planet Socorro, hiding in its temple. She travels with an ''Imperial Knight'' by the name of ''Elke Vetter''. Listen well, Darth Talon. This is what I want&hellip;|Darth Krayt sets Darth Talon on Marasiah Fel's trail|<ref name="Legacy 2" />}}
After [[Attack on Emperor Fel|usurping]] the [[Fel Empire|Imperial]] throne from [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] in [[130 ABY]]<ref name="Legacy 1">[[Legacy (2006) 1|''Legacy'' (2006) 1]]</ref> and sending him into [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]] spent seven [[Standard year/Legends|years]] sending forces of his new [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]] to [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] down both Fel<ref name="Legacy 2" /> and Fel's daughter, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Marasiah Fel|Marasiah]].<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> The Princess often evaded Krayt's [[Agent/Legends|agents]] with the help of [[Imperial Mission]]ary [[Astraal Vao]]&mdash;although the Imperial Mission was attached to Krayt's Empire, Vao was a trusted friend of Marasiah and frequently defied the Empire in order to help her.<ref name="LECG" />

In [[137 ABY]], as the [[Second Imperial Civil War]] raged between Krayt's forces and Fel's [[Empire-in-exile]], Marasiah traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] with her [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Elke Vetter]]. They were on a quest to discern who among Krayt's Empire were still loyal to Marasiah's [[Parent/Legends|father]], and Vao welcomed them into Socorro's [[Imperial Mission temple]]. When Krayt learned of the Princess's whereabouts, he dispatched [[Darth Talon]], his newest [[Hand (One Sith)|Sith Hand]], to chase Marasiah from the temple in the hope that she would lead Krayt's [[One Sith]] to her father.<ref name="Legacy 2" />

==The duel==
{{Quote|Kill me if you will, Sith! The princess has escaped!''"<br />"''Yes. She is with ''Astraal Vao'', the local missionary. The plan was for them to escape.|Elke Vetter and Darth Talon|<ref name="Legacy 2" />}}
[[File:Drainthatknowledge.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Darth Talon rips information from Elke Vetter's mind.]]
Talon arrived on Socorro and set the Imperial Mission Temple on [[Fire/Legends|fire]], which prompted Marasiah and Vao to flee while Vetter engaged the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Hand in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]]. The two [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] in a courtyard of the burning temple until Talon [[Cho mai/Legends|severed]] her opponent's left [[Limb/Legends|hand]] from the wrist, which was followed by a [[Shiak|stab]] to Vetter's right thigh and a kick to her chest. Vetter dropped her [[Imperial Knight lightsaber|lightsaber]] and collapsed to the ground, but she was content in the knowledge that Marasiah had escaped. However, Talon informed her conquered foe that such had been her intention, and she [[Force power/Legends|used]] [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Drain Knowledge|drain knowledge]] of the Princess's destination from Vetter's [[Brain/Legends|mind]]. She then [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Imperial Knight with a blast of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]].<ref name="Legacy 2" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|She's ''dead'', Astraal! The Sith killed Elke! I ''felt'' her die in the Force! Felt her anguish and despair! I'm going back! The Sith needs killing!''"<br />"''No, princess! Please! She gave her ''life'' so you could escape! Returning would only ''dishonor'' her sacrifice!|Marasiah Fel and Astraal Vao react to Vetter's death|<ref name="Legacy 2" />}}
Marasiah felt Vetter's death in the Force and was ready to turn around to avenge her bodyguard, but Vao convinced her to honor Vetter's sacrifice and keep running.<ref name="Legacy 2" /> Vao soon afterward contacted her brother, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Shado Vao]], and arranged to meet him on the planet [[Vendaxa/Legends|Vendaxa]]. The two arranged passage offworld on the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Helot-class medium space transport|vessel]] [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']], but Talon was already aware of their destination<ref name="Legacy 3" /> and followed them there. When the Sith Hand [[Skirmish on Vendaxa|attacked]] the group, Marasiah fought furiously in order to prevent Talon from again killing someone who had risen to the Princess's defense.<ref name="Legacy 5" /> News of Vetter's death and Marasiah's escape reached Roan Fel's [[Ear/Legends|ears]] on his new [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]], but he resisted the urge to mount a rescue attempt in order to keep his [[Fall of Bastion|recent capture]] of Bastion a secret.<ref name="Legacy 3" /> The Imperial Knight [[Antares Draco]], who was in love with the Princess, defied Fel's orders and set out for Vendaxa with his friend and fellow Knight [[Ganner Krieg]].<ref name="Legacy 6">[[Legacy (2006) 6|''Legacy'' (2006) 6]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Talon actually sliced at the point where the bracer and hand guard join. Even the best of armor has it's ''[sic]'' weaknesses and Talon took advantage of that weakness with the precision of her strike.|Jan Duursema|<ref name="Jan" />}}
The duel between [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Talon and Elke Vetter is featured in the [[Legacy (2006) 2|second issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]] ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''; written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Jan Duursema]], the issue was released in [[July]] [[2006]]. The duel sees Talon sever Vetter's hand from her arm,<ref name="Legacy 2" /> but ''Legacy''{{'s}} [[Legacy (2006) 13|thirteenth issue]] later revealed that every Imperial Knight wears [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-resistant [[Cortosis gauntlet/Legends|cortosis gauntlets]] on their wrists.<ref name="Legacy 13">[[Legacy (2006) 13|''Legacy'' (2006) 13]]</ref> In [[2010]], Duursema confirmed that Vetter's hand is sliced off at a point outside of the gauntlet's protection.<ref name="Jan">{{DHBoards|url=viewtopic.php?t=16707#236057|thread=About the Imperial Knights' cortosis gaunltets|author=[[Jan Duursema|jan duursema]]|date=2010-01-02|time=10:42 pm}}</ref>
